purpose: Determine whether same-definition statutory capex and OCF exist for 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 and 2025-04-01 to 2025-06-30, so FY2026 + Q1FY2027 - Q1FY2026 can form an official TTM ended 2026-06-30. Not a canvas or repository change. NVDA not in scope.

verdict.exact_blocker: The unaudited condensed consolidated statements of cash flows in both the FY2027 Q1 6-K (accession 0001104659-26-099220, EX-99.1, printed page 21) and the FY2026 Q1 6-K (accession 0001104659-25-085638, EX-99.1, printed page 20) present only three cash-flow totals (operating, investing, financing). Neither exhibit presents the statutory line 'Acquisitions of: Land use rights, property and equipment' for the three months ended June 30, 2026 or June 30, 2025. The current-period statutory line is therefore also missing. A same-definition statutory capex TTM (FY2026 + Q1FY2027 - Q1FY2026) cannot be constructed. This absence is not filled by the narrower FCF reconciliation PPE line or by MD&A 'capital expenditures' amounts; those are recorded below but are not treated as the missing CF line.

do_not_mix.reason: FY2026 statutory capex is the cash-flow statement land/property/equipment acquisitions line. FY2027 Q1 and FY2026 Q1 official exhibits only present the narrower FCF recon item 'Purchase of property and equipment (excluding land use rights and construction in progress relating to office campuses)'. These are different captions. Quarterly MD&A capital expenditures also differ from the narrow PPE amounts (67,678 vs 67,660; 38,676 vs 38,629) and are not used as the unpresented statutory CF line.
